# Simulated Night Vision Experience
The MOKNVG simulates dummy night vision effect with realistic device operations, offering an immersive and interactive experience.

**Features**
- Customizable dummy NVG effect (with color adjustment)
- Fully interactable NVG device functions
- Supports both controller and hand interactions
- Adjustable focus effect and DoF center mask for aiming with optics(Quest 3 only)

**Interactable Controls**
- Flip-down
- Forward / Back adjustment
- Side flip rotation
- Left / Right switch
- Pod power switch
- Focus control
- Manual gain control

**Current available NVG type**
- Monocular  NVG

**Notice**
- Current camera input has a 40–60 ms delay
-  Input image is not fully accurate due to limitations in the API used during app development

- Play safe and watch your surroundings!

**Requred Device** 
- Quest 3 / Quest 3S
- Must be running Horizon OS v74 or higher
